description: This PHP file defines a data dictionary class for interacting with DB2 databases within the ADOdb library. It includes methods for altering tables, dropping columns, and handling data types specific to DB2.

classes.name: ADODB2_db2
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict to implement DB2-specific database schema operations and data type handling.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps meta types to DB2 actual data types, with support for custom meta types.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix for column creation with default value, nullability, identity, and constraints.

methods.name: alterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter column definitions in a DB2 table.

methods.name: dropColumnSql
methods.description: Produces SQL statements to drop columns from a DB2 table.

methods.name: changeTableSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL statements for modifying table schemas, handling character and non-character columns appropriately.
